description: This file defines functions and types for creating and managing test environments within Mattermost, including creating test teams, users, channels, and posts for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestEnvironment
classes.description: Struct representing a test environment with multiple teams and their respective environments.

methods.name: CreateTestEnvironmentWithTeams
methods.description: Creates a test environment with multiple teams, including users, channels, and posts, with options for fuzziness and range specifications.

methods.name: CreateTestEnvironmentInTeam
methods.description: Creates a test environment within a specific team, including users, channels, and posts, with options for fuzziness and range specifications.
